messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync after the Acme call. They insisted SSO for pilot. Our options: delay MVP to add full SAML, offer invite-only pilot, or ship a minimal tenant routing + admin token solution. Leaning toward invite pilot to keep launch date. Thoughts?
Mike (Eng Lead): Full SAML in MVP is high risk. Cert handling, IDP metadata permutations, edge-case mapping. Would add ~4 dev-weeks. Not great.
Kartik (Infra): We can do tenant routing + an admin invite flow in ~6 dev-days. Full SAML needs infra cert infra + mapping work. Could phase SSO: auth core (2w) then SAML specifics (2w).
Sarah (Research): Acme said security review expects SAML, but they might accept a documented pilot workaround. They were explicit about this being non-negotiable for GA, though.
Jill (UX): Invite flow + admin console updates are straightforward. Estimate: 2 design sprints + 1 polish sprint for copy and edge-case flows.
Sales: If we do invite-only pilot, we must give Acme a written pilot scope and clearly labeled limitations. They'll want that for internal compliance.
Legal: We'll need to review pilot language; should be fast if Sales drafts a clear scope and risk note.
Anya (PM): Proposal: cut full SAML to v1, ship tenant routing + invite pilot in MVP, and add phased SSO to roadmap. Keep Nov 12 launch. Approve?
Mike (Eng Lead): Vote: cut SSO to v1. Implement feature flags so we can flip enterprise SSO when ready.
Kartik (Infra): Agreed. We'll add telemetry for tenant route mismatches during canary.
Jill (UX): I'll push invite UX mocks by Thu.
Mike (Eng Lead): I'll open a cutlist PR and add feature flags + telemetry hooks.
Sales: I'll draft pilot scope and request NDA/MSA. Will loop Legal.
Legal: Once Sales posts draft, we can review same-day.
deploy-bot: Release board updated  canary Nov10-11, prod Nov12.
Anya (PM): Action items: Mike PR EOD, Jill mocks Thu, Sales pilot doc by tomorrow, Legal review by 3pm tomorrow. I'll update roadmap and customer note.
Mike (Eng Lead): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/847  cutlist + flags. Please review.
Kartik (Infra): Added alert request to infra board: tenant-route-mismatch >0.5% during canary.
Anya (PM): Closing thread. I'll post follow-up with milestone tracker, CR links, and customer communication.
